notes.title: Captain's Log: Day Ending
notes.notes:
[i]Internal monologue voiced by Morgan Freeman
(but like... how he sounds in the Shawshank Redemption... like OLD SKOOL Morgan!)[/i]


As I float here... exhausted from my never-ending internal questions, external screaming... and general "cannae be bothered" attitude... I let my eyes slowly close, and my mind drift to a peaceful quietness.

It's been... so long... since I had one of those godlike power naps... You know... the ones where you wake up after 45 minutes and feel like a new person... or banana? Maybe I'll just switch off and just accept that it is what it is....

Maybe this is my last entry... maybe not...? Who knows...

I look out across the vastness of Space, and the infinitesimal impact my life will have on it... and I wonder if anyone will even read these logs. All my precious thoughts... lost to the annals of time. Oh well...

Live long and prosper, fellow Space man.

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day Unknown
notes.notes:
I mean, when life gives you never-ending silence and a crippling realisation of total abandonment... why not create Haikus to mask those growing fears of a meaningless existence...?


A vacuous pool
Never-ending, it's cold touch
Oh God I'm a fruit

From starchy to sweet
The yellow sun sets to night
The lone star wanders

Stars fall in silence
A chill dances in the air
Moonlight bathes my soul

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day Banana
notes.notes:
[i]A banana is an elongated, edible fruit – botanically a berry – produced by several kinds of large herbaceous flowering plants in the genus Musa. In some countries, bananas used for cooking may be called "plantains", distinguishing them from dessert bananas. The fruit is variable in size, colour, and firmness, but is usually elongated and curved, with soft flesh rich in starch covered with a rind, which may be green, yellow, red, purple, or brown when ripe. The fruits grow in clusters hanging from the top of the plant. Almost all modern edible seedless (parthenocarp) bananas come from two wild species – Musa acuminata and Musa balbisiana. The scientific names of most cultivated bananas are Musa acuminata, Musa balbisiana, and Musa × paradisiaca for the hybrid Musa acuminata × M. balbisiana, depending on their genomic constitution. The old scientific name for this hybrid, Musa sapientum, is no longer used.

Musa species are native to tropical Indomalaya and Australia, and are likely to have been first domesticated in Papua New Guinea.They are grown in 135 countries. primarily for their fruit, and to a lesser extent to make fiber, banana wine, and banana beer and as ornamental plants. The world's largest producers of bananas in 2017 were India and China, which together accounted for approximately 38% of total production.

Worldwide, there is no sharp distinction between "bananas" and "plantains". Especially in the Americas and Europe, "banana" usually refers to soft, sweet, dessert bananas, particularly those of the Cavendish group, which are the main exports from banana-growing countries. By contrast, Musa cultivars with firmer, starchier fruit are called "plantains". In other regions, such as Southeast Asia, many more kinds of banana are grown and eaten, so the binary distinction is not useful and is not made in local languages.

The term "banana" is also used as the common name for the plants that produce the fruit. This can extend to other members of the genus Musa, such as the scarlet banana (Musa coccinea), the pink banana (Musa velutina), and the Fe'i bananas. It can also refer to members of the genus Ensete, such as the snow banana (Ensete glaucum) and the economically important false banana (Ensete ventricosum). Both genera are in the banana family, Musaceae.[/i]

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Banana]Source.[/url]

notes.title: Captain's Log: Order #343
notes.notes: Hi there, I'd like to order the chicken and cashew nuts with a small side of sweet and sour sauce. Can I also get a number two rice please, with extra sauce. Do you have prawn crackers? You know how sometimes places give prawn crackers in a lil' bag for free, do you guys dance that dance? I mean I don’t mind paying... Either way, I just wanna get my p-crawn on. Peee craaaaawn.

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day 14
notes.notes:
Mission Control… we have a [i]serious[/i] problem.
Come in, Mission Control…
Mission Control, do you copy?
Mission Control, we have a [b]Threat Level "Number Two"[/b] situation here, [b]DO. YOU. COPY?[/b]

...[I]silence[/i]...

Can [i]anybody[/i] hear me?????

I know I’ve been talking to myself for… what… fourteen days now?? But this is absolute life or death. Please give me something. Show me a sign. Anything! PLEASE!??

Oh God. Oh man. Oh God, oh God, holy moly, oh boooyy, oh mannnnnnnnn.

It's been fourteen days, man... [b]FOURTEEEEEEEN![/b]. It’s been fourteen days and I haven’t gone to the toilet. Fourteen days! Is this witchcraft?? Am I in some sort of magical witchcraft Hell dungeon???

I came to terms with being a banana, but… not needing to go to the TOILET?! This is absurd! This is unnatural! This is WRONG! I cant deal with this.

[h3]MISSION CONTROL, COME IN PLEASE??[/h3]

Oh man, what have I become?! Some godless demon who never has to relieve himself? This is low. This is the lowest of the low. This is loowwww down. This is canyon depth... this is marinara trench depth. Is that what it's called? Marinara? Maraca? Whatever! We’re deep now fellas! [i]Deep dish deep[/i].

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day Z7KL9
notes.notes:
Weooooooooow. [i][b]Weeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee[/b][/i]. [h2]Waaaahoooooooooooooooooooooo[/h2]

How good is spinning? [i][b]Wwweeeaaaaaaoooooooo[/b][/i]. Man, people really overlooked the whole spinning thing. We should have worked that out [i]waaaay[/i] sooner. I mean look at [b]*THIS*[/b] cool spin move... [b]KA-CHOW![/b]. 

Man, spinning is awesome. Hey... need me to grab something for you? No problem, I’ll just [i]spiiiiiinnnnnn[/i] my way over here. Oh, you needed that thing too? No problem, Imma just [i]sppiiiiiiihiiiiiin[/i] my way over there. Oh, is that a sweet ass Beatles song I hear playing in the pleasure chamber? Let me show you some of my SCHWEET, [i]spiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiin[/i] manoeuvres. [i]*winks at camera*[/i]

[h3]Weeeeo0000oooo0o00o0o0ooo00wwww.[/h3]

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day 5
notes.notes:
It took a couple of days, and a LOT of thinking, but I think I’ve got it figured out. I was taking the bus to work one day, had my headphones on, my breakfast bagel in one hand and my crossword in the other. It was a great morning. A great Tuesday morning. I think it was a Tuesday? It must have been a Tuesday, Tuesday is breakfast bagel day. They only do breakfast bagels on Tuesdays. Of COURSE it was a Tuesday. 

Anyway, I’m buying this bagel as it was my birthday; and what better a day to treat yourself to a Tuesday breakfast bagel than a Tuesday breakfast [b]BIRTHDAY[/b] bagel right????? So the bagel guy asks me what I’ve got going on today, and I tell him it’s my birthday. He goes [i]“Oh, Happy Birthday!”[/i] and I said [i]“You too!”[/I].

Can you believe that?! [b][i]"You too?"[/i][/b] This is why I'm a banana. I’m being punished. I’m being punished for not being able to have simple interactions with other humans. I can repair and build a WHOLE depressurization chamber in 13 hours but I can’t SMALL TALK my bagel guy? This is my penance. How long does penance usually last? Like a couple of weeks right?

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day 3
notes.notes:
You know what’s something? You know what’s a nice, little bonus point up here? The views... Ain’t [i]never[/i] seen anything like it before. I did a drawing so I’d never forget what it looked like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38009404/62e3a75d674e6657566ba7b799b9d5806b8b6fae.png[/img]

Is that not really something? Woah. I mean, [i]wow man[/I]... Just look at it. So many thoughts, and feelings, and emotions. Banana emotions. They’re kinda like regular emotions except… sweeter. They’re softer in my brain. It’s like a big, mushy cuddle. 

You know when you wake up super sleepy, you’ve just done your business and you’re washing your hands… then the warm tap hits you and… damn. Its like a liquidy cuddle for your hands. So you just kinda... stand there... with your hands in the sink for a little bit, getting a warm, little cuddle from the tap. It’s... nice... It's [i]real nice[/i]. Man, I miss having hands.

notes.title: Captain's Log: Day 1
notes.notes:
I mean to be honest it feels [i]great[/i]. It feels pretty great being a banana. I feel pretty well put together, 'cause I'm still sealed, you know?

I don't know how I'd feel if i was an opened banana, I'd feel a little exposed. But this is nice, y'know? This is sorta... no bruises. 

I'm a nice, yellow banana. I'm actually a pretty attractive banana. I mean... really... I'm a [i]pretty attractive banana[/i]. I feel like the best banana in the bunch. [b]I feel like the best banana in the bunch![/b] I mean, I'm the only banana in the bunch. BUT STILL! I feel pretty hoop-diddily fantastic about this right now. 

I think I've always been a banana... somewhere... deep down inside. And in fact, I think we all are.... I think I've always been a banana, deep inside. Deep. Somewhere deep down inside me. I think we all are. 

Score 1 for me, [b]Score 1 for the banana.[/b]
